what: Fitted coefficients of the chelation propensity index (CPI) logistic classifier, used by the battery posterior verification funnel to separate weakly solvating electrolytes (CPI < 0.5) from conventional dilute electrolytes.
formula: CPI = 0.355*SASA(O/N,max) + 0.110*Num(13O) + 0.044*Num(14O) + 0.006*Num(15O) - 0.012, on features divided by the recorded means
fitted_on: 46 molecules of CPI/Input/Features-NoF.csv, 21 WSE and 25 CDE
why_committed: scripts/download_data.py did not fetch this file, so data/raw/battslm/chelation_propensity_index.py had an implementation and no coefficients and predict_cpi() could not run. It is 405 bytes.
citation: Z.-Y. Zhang, R. Mercado, T. T. Le, C. Zhang, ACS Nano 2026, 20, 20714-20729, doi 10.1021/acsnano.6c06255
